records.deadline_display: You must apply by the December or January admissions deadline, whichever is relevant to your course in order to be considered. Deadline information is available on the graduate course pages.

source.raw_extract: By applying for graduate study you will automatically be considered for a Clarendon scholarship. You do not need to submit any additional documents and there are no separate scholarship application forms for Clarendon. You must apply by the December or January admissions deadline, whichever is relevant to your course in order to be considered. Deadline information is available on the graduate course pages.

source.notes: Fetched live via a headless browser with a standard desktop user agent; direct HTTP fetches of www.ox.ac.uk return a Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' challenge (HTTP 403), and the shard's official_source_url https://www.ox.ac.uk/clarendon redirects to https://www.ox.ac.uk/admissions/graduate/fees-and-funding/funding/clarendon, which was also fetched. No separate Clarendon application or single fixed date exists. The deadline is explicitly deferred to the applicant's own course deadline and is expressed only as the months December or January with no day. Classified MONTH (source gives a month window, no day); deadline_date stays null. No day was inferred and no other course's date was substituted.

records.title: Weidenfeld-Hoffmann Scholarships and Leadership Programme
records.deadline_display: In order to be considered for this scholarship, you must select the Weidenfeld-Hoffmann Scholarships and Leadership Programme in the University of Oxford Scholarships section of the University's graduate application form and submit your application for graduate study by the relevant December or January deadline for your course. See the relevant course page for the deadline applicable to your course.

source.as_of: 2027/28 cycle (page carries the 'Weidenfeld-Hoffmann Scholarships Statement 2027/28'; states decisions expected by end of May 2027 and interview likely April 2027)
source.raw_extract: In order to be considered for this scholarship, you must select the Weidenfeld-Hoffmann Scholarships and Leadership Programme in the University of Oxford Scholarships section of the University's graduate application form and submit your application for graduate study by the relevant December or January deadline for your course. See the relevant course page for the deadline applicable to your course. You must also complete a Weidenfeld-Hoffmann Scholarships Statement and upload it, together with your graduate application form, by the deadline. ... To be eligible for consideration for this scholarship, applicants must be successful in being offered a place on their course after consideration of applications received by the relevant December or January deadline for the course. Course applications which are held over after the December or January deadline to be re-evaluated against applications received by the March deadline or course applications which have been put on a waiting list are not eligible for scholarship consideration.
source.exact_deadline_wording: submit your application for graduate study by the relevant December or January deadline for your course
source.notes: Fetched live via a headless browser with a standard desktop user agent; direct HTTP fetches of www.ox.ac.uk return a Cloudflare challenge (HTTP 403). The page gives the application deadline only as 'the relevant December or January deadline for your course', with no day, and explicitly points to individual course pages for the applicable date. The page also states the page's current cycle (2027/28) but never states a single calendar deadline for the scholarship. Classified MONTH; deadline_date stays null. The page's stated dates (April 2027 interview, end of May 2027 decisions) are outcomes/administrative milestones, NOT an application deadline, and were deliberately not used as one. No course's admissions deadline was borrowed.

source.notes: Fetched live; the shard's official_source_url resolved correctly. This is a recurring annual window, so it is classified ANNUAL with precision 'recurring' and deadline_date stays null. source.raw_extract:
How to apply

You do not need to apply for this scholarship.

We will assess your qualifications provided in your application when you apply to study at QUT, or when you articulate to your next course in your package offer, for an eligible course, and we will let you know if you meet the criteria.

What happens next?

If you are eligible, you will receive a scholarship offer along with your admissions offer letter.
source.notes: The shard's official_source_url was successfully retrieved live via a headless browser (direct webfetch of the same URL exceeded the 5MB response limit, so the rendered page text was read instead). The full rendered scholarship page was read end to end, including the Scholarship details, Eligibility, Eligible courses, How to apply, What happens next and About the scholarship sections. It contains no closing date, no application deadline, no key-dates block and no reference to a semester intake closing date anywhere; the only date-like string on the page is the footer 'Page updated: 13 August 2026'. The page states there is no separate application, which means eligibility is assessed with the admissions application, but it does NOT explicitly say the deadline is rolling or that there is no fixed deadline, so ROLLING was not claimed. Outcome UNKNOWN per brief section 3: evidence insufficient, no calendar date inferred from QUT's generic admissions cycle.
